loginRoute.title: Start login
loginRoute.summary: The route validates the destination, invokes LoginService.begin and sets a browser-binding cookie.
talk: The route validates the destination, invokes LoginService.begin and sets a browser-binding cookie.

begin.title: Create a login attempt
begin.summary: Generate state, browser binding and PKCE material; persist a short-lived attempt.
talk: The provider builds the authorization URL before the attempt is stored. Raw session credentials are not stored in PostgreSQL.

url.title: Build the provider redirect
url.summary: CognitoIdentityProvider builds the Cognito authorization URL.
talk: Show the PKCE challenge, state and callback parameters in the authorization URL.

attemptStore.title: Store the attempt
attemptStore.summary: Persist the login attempt with bounded cleanup and admission in the access adapter.
talk: Persist the login attempt with bounded cleanup and admission in the access adapter.

callbackRoute.title: Complete the callback
callbackRoute.summary: Read code/state and the binding cookie, then set the local session cookie after successful login.
talk: Read code/state and the binding cookie, then set the local session cookie after successful login.

complete.title: Bind identity to a seeded user
complete.summary: Consume the attempt, exchange the code, find a seeded user and create a fixed-expiry local session.
talk: Provider identity establishes who signed in. The application-owned role determines what they may access.
The provider exchange runs outside a database transaction.

consume.title: Consume once
consume.summary: Atomically consume an unexpired attempt matching both state and browser binding.
talk: Atomically consume an unexpired attempt matching both state and browser binding.

exchange.title: Exchange and verify
exchange.summary: Exchange the authorization code with PKCE and verify the returned identity.
talk: Exchange the authorization code with PKCE and verify the returned identity.

verify.title: Verify provider claims
verify.summary: Inspect signature and trusted token claims before producing a verified identity.
talk: Inspect signature and trusted token claims before producing a verified identity.

findUser.title: Find the seeded account
findUser.summary: Look up the application user by verified issuer and subject.
talk: Look up the application user by verified issuer and subject.

sessionStore.title: Persist the local session
sessionStore.summary: Store the token digest, user and fixed expiry. The raw token returns only to the browser.
talk: Store the token digest, user and fixed expiry. The raw token returns only to the browser.

sessionRoute.title: Read current identity
sessionRoute.summary: The authenticated decorator supplies the current identity for the JSON response.
talk: The authenticated decorator supplies the current identity for the JSON response.

current.title: Build current identity
current.summary: Resolve the local session and derive a CSRF token without extending its expiry.
talk: Resolve the local session and derive a CSRF token without extending its expiry.

resolve.title: Resolve current access
resolve.summary: Validate the token and load a currently valid local session.
talk: Validate the token and load a currently valid local session.

resolveStore.title: Read session and role
resolveStore.summary: Resolve the session against current application user information and expiry.
talk: Resolve the session against current application user information and expiry.

authorize.title: Authorize the use case
authorize.summary: Resolve fresh access and apply the pure role policy before protected work.
talk: Resolve fresh access and apply the pure role policy before protected work.

policy.title: Apply role-only policy
policy.summary: Viewer reads national data; Analyst reads all grains; Admin additionally manages refresh.
talk: Viewer reads national data; Analyst reads all grains; Admin additionally manages refresh.

logoutRoute.title: Log out this session
logoutRoute.summary: Validate mutation protection, revoke a valid session and clear the browser cookie.
talk: Validate mutation protection, revoke a valid session and clear the browser cookie.

csrf.title: Protect browser mutations
csrf.summary: Resolve the current session and verify the supplied CSRF token.
talk: Resolve the current session and verify the supplied CSRF token.

logout.title: Revoke the supplied token
logout.summary: Revoke only this token digest; other independently established sessions remain valid.
talk: Revoke only this token digest; other independently established sessions remain valid.

revoke.title: Record revocation
talk: Persist revocation in PostgreSQL.

wiring.title: Compose dependencies
wiring.summary: Bootstrap injects the access store, Cognito provider and services; routes translate HTTP.
talk: Bootstrap injects the access store, Cognito provider and services; routes translate HTTP.

attempt.title: LoginAttempt
attempt.summary: A browser-bound, single-use attempt. Example is a partial shape; placeholders are not credentials.
talk: A browser-bound, single-use attempt. Example is a partial shape; placeholders are not credentials.

user.title: SeededUser
user.summary: Verified provider linkage plus one application-owned role.
talk: Verified provider linkage plus one application-owned role.

session.title: Session
session.summary: A local session with fixed establishment and expiry times. Partial illustrative shape.
talk: A local session with fixed establishment and expiry times. Partial illustrative shape.

credential.title: Read the session cookie
credential.summary: Read the configured application session cookie from the incoming browser request.
talk: Read the configured application session cookie from the incoming browser request.

flows.title: High-level diagram
flows.lead: Cognito verifies who you are. The application finds your seeded account, creates a session and uses your current role to decide what you may do.
flows.heading: Sign in once. Check access on every request.

lanes.title: Sign in
lanes.caption: The browser follows redirects; the API completes verification with Cognito.

steps.title: Start a login
steps.text: The API records a short-lived attempt tied to this browser.

steps.title: Verify credentials
steps.text: Cognito checks the credentials. Open the API integration that sends the browser to Cognito.

steps.title: Verify the identity
steps.text: Match and consume the attempt, exchange the code and verify the provider’s answer.

steps.title: Find the local account
steps.text: Require an existing seeded user and read their application role.

steps.title: Create a session
steps.text: Store a fixed-expiry session and return its cookie to the browser.

lanes.title: Use the application
lanes.caption: Repeat this access decision for protected operations, including later data pages.

steps.title: Send the session cookie
steps.text: The browser supplies its session. Open the API code that reads the cookie.

steps.title: Check current access
steps.text: Resolve the session, expiry and current application role.

steps.title: Allow or deny
steps.text: Apply the role policy before accessing protected data.

steps.title: Return the outcome
steps.text: Return the allowed result or an access error without protected data.

boundaries: Cognito owns credential verification; application roles come from PostgreSQL.
Activity does not extend expiry. Logout revokes only the supplied session.
Missing, expired or reused attempts and unknown seeded users cannot create a session.
